validity.recommendation: Two separate actions. (1) STATUS: proposed -> approved; FERC issued the CP25-94-000 certificate 3/19/2026 per the EIA Aug 2026 release. (2) ATTRIBUTION, the bigger finding: this row is filed under PipelineName 'Transcontinental Gas Pipeline' with Owner 'Transco [100.%]', but the Decatur Lateral Project is a ROCKIES EXPRESS PIPELINE LLC (Tallgrass) project. FERC's scoping notice in Docket CP25-94-000 names Rockies Express Pipeline, LLC as the section 7(c) applicant; the project's own site decaturlateral.com agrees; and EIA lists REX as operator in every release from Oct 2025 onward (only its first, Jul 2025, said Transcontinental, and EIA corrected it). Transco is a Williams system serving the Gulf Coast-to-Northeast corridor and does not operate in Illinois -- EIA's Transco entries are in GA, LA, AL, PA/NJ/NY and VA/NC/SC/GA/AL, never IL. Recommend re-parenting the row to Rockies Express and changing Owner accordingly. Specs are not in dispute: 16.7 mi total (15.9-mi lateral + 0.8-mi ADM Spur), 20 in, 181.4 MMcf/d, Macon County IL -- all match the sheet within rounding.
